name: szmelc-rce
description: Szmelc-INC Remote Control Extension - self-hostable browser remote control (MV3, forked from Claude in Chrome)

scripts.test:all: node test/bridge.test.mjs && node test/nativehost.test.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/e2e-bridge.mjs
scripts.crx:verify: crx3-verify rsa 0 key.local.crx.pem < dist/szmelc-rce.crx 2>/dev/null || node -e "console.log('self-verify in build already covers this')"
